shadow.comparisons: Same observed state and latent proposal, recompute canonical native F and tail F=0.125*proposal holding. Report reserve/floor conditions separately from actual holding changes. Recorded action overrides at selected train issues are explicit.

intervention.gate: Review material holding differences within the fixed three factual300-second neighborhoods. Record the evidence and decision once, before submitting native branches; no reward-based anchor selection.
intervention.treatment: Native replay and first action/batch unchanged. On subsequent batches only replace the execution mapping with tail F; actor inputs and environment keep actual time. Freeze all learning.

invariants.trust: Original v18 trust formula and prefix updates; zero suffix policy/world/trust/readout updates.

diagnostic_compute_budget.prefix_replay: Record native prefix seconds and replayed label/update counts separately. Prefix replays reproduce original285-budget history, not new independent labels.
